description: This PHP class defines the 'Customer' entity used in the OrangeHRM TimePlugin module, representing customer data with properties such as id, deletion status, name, and description. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and maintains a collection of associated projects.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Entity class representing a customer in the HRM system with ORM mappings and related properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the customer.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the customer.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the customer is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the customer as deleted or not.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the customer.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the customer.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the customer.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the customer.
